integrity: A complete combinatorial integral homotopy proof and 72 finite exhaustive corroborations are supplied. Priority searches are non-exhaustive; no independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for two shores of sizes at least three and only cross-edge faults sharing one fixed hub. No statement about arbitrary fault graphs, higher independence thresholds or the full automorphism action.
title: Integral circle persistence under clustered star-edge faults in biclique dissociation complexes
